title: Paystride Visa Payroll Card Advantage: Liability Counted on Resolved Claims of a Loss
content:
**For a signed lost or stolen card claim on the Paystride Visa Payroll Card Advantage plan:**

| | |
|---|---|
| A claim's loss | the account's unauthorized-transaction claims carrying its loss date |
| Order of counting | the loss's claims resolved with an error found, each at its disputed amount, count before any claim still under investigation, whatever their posting order |
| Date the loss was reported | the date of the account's single lost or stolen replacement order placed on or after the loss date, among its orders of the last 12 months |
| Late report | more than 2 business days after the loss date |

**Liability already charged on the same loss:**
- when the loss carries claims resolved with an error found and the report was late, the lesser of their total disputed amount and 500.00;
- when it carries such claims and the report was not late, the lesser of that total and 50.00;
- otherwise, nothing.

Business days are Monday through Friday excluding Federal Reserve holidays, counted from the day after the earlier date through the later one.

## Points of judgement (hypothetical)

1. A claim still under investigation on the same loss adds nothing, however early it posted.
2. Resolved claims of 12.60 and 9.15 with a timely report give 21.75.
3. A single resolved claim of 75.00 with a timely report gives 50.00. With a late report it gives 75.00.
